subject: AWS Marketplace private offer renewal — logistics & billing alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.r@ampgenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace private offer renewal — logistics & billing alignment

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. AmpGen's renewal for the AWS private offer is coming up in March and we wanted to align on a few operational items so the transition is seamless on your side: 

- Billing flow: do you want Redwood to invoice AmpGen directly (monthly) or continue via AWS Marketplace (upfront commitment billed by AWS)?
- PO and signature: I’ve attached a draft of the PO + our standard PO terms for review (AmpGen_AWS_PO_Draft_v3.pdf, PO-terms-2026.docx).
- Procurement form: if you prefer AWS billing, please send your procurement form or confirm the billing contact at AWS.

Proposed next steps: can we lock billing method and procurement contact by Feb 22 so we can generate the final private offer and routing for the March 1 renewal? Marissa is on copy to help run the paperwork.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: AmpGen_AWS_PO_Draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf), PO-terms-2026.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Claire Reynolds <claire.r@ampgenhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@ampgenhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer renewal — logistics & billing alignment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement:

- Our preference is to continue with the AWS Marketplace private offer so licensing appears on our AWS bill (this simplifies consolidation). However, our finance team requires a net-30 payment term on the Marketplace invoice.
- I’ve attached our vendor procurement worksheet (AmpGen_Procurement_Form_2026.xlsx) with the required billing contact and tax details.
- We also need Redwood to confirm how monthly usage reporting will be surfaced (CSV vs. consolidated invoice) — our accounting team is strict about reconciliation fields.

Can you confirm: if we keep Marketplace billing, will Redwood be able to provide a monthly usage CSV (s3 link or attachment) with token-level and commitment credit lines? Also, does the private offer support invoice net terms on AWS side or will AmpGen need to pay AWS and then be reimbursed?

Claire Reynolds
Director, IT Procurement | AmpGen Health
claire.r@ampgenhealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.r@ampgenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer renewal — logistics & billing alignment

Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the procurement worksheet. I looped Sean (finance) into this thread so we can confirm the invoice mechanics and net-30 request. Summary and proposed approach below: 

Summary of options
- Option A (preferred by AmpGen): Keep AWS Marketplace private offer. Charges appear on AmpGen's AWS bill; Redwood provides monthly usage CSV and detailed line-items for reconciliation. AWS issues the invoice; AmpGen pays AWS on net-30.
- Option B: Redwood invoices AmpGen directly (monthly). Redwood applies commitment credits and shows usage breakdown; AmpGen pays Redwood net-30. This avoids AWS invoice terms but requires AmpGen PO to Redwood.

What we can do now
- We can keep the private offer in AWS and generate a reconciliation CSV monthly with token-level usage + commitment credits. We will surface it via a secure S3 link and cc your billing contact.
- Regarding net-30 on Marketplace invoices: AWS billing typically follows AWS terms; Redwood cannot change AWS's payment terms. If AmpGen requires net-30 on their payable, Option B would be the way to get net-30 to Redwood.

Next steps
1) If AmpGen confirms Option A, send the AWS billing contact and we'll provision the S3 reporting + update the private offer to include the AmpGen billing alias.
2) If AmpGen prefers Option B, provide PO number and we will issue monthly invoices to AmpGen (we can attach usage CSVs).

I’ve attached an updated PO draft with a placeholder for the chosen billing path (AmpGen_AWS_PO_Draft_v3.pdf). Marissa will help with the private offer setup in the marketplace console if you choose Option A.

Would you and procurement be able to confirm by EOD Feb 24? If helpful, we can do a 20‑minute call to walk finance through the reconciliation fields.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.r@ampgenhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer renewal — logistics & billing alignment

Hi Claire / Karthik,

Thanks — looping finance in to confirm the final routing. Quick answers from Redwood Finance: 

- We can support Option A (Marketplace billing) operationally by provisioning a monthly S3 usage CSV that contains: invoice period, aws_account_id, charge_line_description, usage_tokens, commitment_credit, and total_amount. We'll include reconciliation IDs to match your AP fields.
- We cannot change AWS's payment terms; AWS invoices will follow AWS's payment cadence. If AmpGen requires net-30 on the payable entity, Redwood is happy to accept a direct PO (Option B) moving forward.
- For the renewal on March 1, we recommend Option A to avoid gaps; we'll provision the CSV starting with March invoices and provide a one-time CSV backfill for Feb.

Action items:
- Claire / Procurement: confirm Option A by Feb 28 and provide the AWS billing alias + billing contact to be granted read/report access.
- Karthik / Marissa: please prepare the private offer update and set up the S3 reporting bucket with restricted access.
- Once confirmed, we’ll send a DocuSign envelope for the PO if AmpGen prefers Option B instead. (DocuSign link will be sent by Redwood legal / ops).

Claire — happy to set a 20-minute call with our billing ops and your AP team next week to walk through the CSV columns if helpful.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: none
